title: Riot finally broke the emergency glass.

themes.title: Champion balance
themes.description: 1 champion buffs, 6 nerfs in this patch (excluding pure bugfixes).

summary: Riot finally broke the emergency glass. Structured changes across 21 entities this patch.

champions.name: Alistar
champions.gameplayImpact: Alistar loses power in the listed areas. Mains should adjust builds/play patterns; counters get an easier time.

champions.name: Ashe
champions.gameplayImpact: Ashe was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

champions.name: Bel'Veth
champions.tldr: Bonus attack speed per stack increased to 0.28–1.1% from 0.28+0.045*(x-1) for 17%. Now also scales until level 18 instead of 17.; Base damage reduced to 0–20 from 10–30.
champions.gameplayImpact: Bel'Veth was adjusted in mixed directions. Net power depends on playstyle — read the numbers before assuming a free buff or hard nerf.

champions.name: Kled
champions.tldr: New Effect: While dismounted, Kled now also gains 4 bonus armor and magic resistance, increased for each nearby enemy champion.; Bonus resistances per nearby enemy increased to 30% from 20%.
champions.gameplayImpact: Kled is stronger on paper. Expect a higher presence until the meta adapts; good time to learn or re-pick them.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: New Effect: While dismounted, Kled now also gains 4 bonus armor and magic resistance, increased for each nearby enemy champion.

lines.label: Bonus resistances per nearby enemy
lines.note: Bonus resistances per nearby enemy increased to 30% from 20%.

lines.label: Maximum bonus resistances
lines.note: Maximum bonus resistances increased to 250% of the minimum from 200%.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Bug Fix: Refunding an item during the remount sequence no longer causes Kled to perform the remount sequence but without actually switching the player to the mounted ability set.

lines.label: Change
lines.note: Undocumented / Bug Fix: Is no longer able to damage minion, small pet, and small monsters with its area check, resulting in double the intended damage in case both the projectile and area check hit the target.

lines.label: Change
